answer: Payouts in our market scale with how many unrelated buyers an ID has finished paid jobs for, and a buyer counts only if its own job graph barely overlaps with others. Each fake needs about 30 real jobs from fresh clients, roughly $90 of actual work a month. A farm can't reuse clients, because shared buyers cluster and the whole group gets zeroed, so 100 fakes need 3,000 distinct buyers. The Zephyr operator on Dune built a haven of 40 IDs trading with each other, and the graph check flagged all 40 within a week.
